q: Why separate instructions and data with tags or headings?
options: So the model can tell what to do from what to work on
It is required by all APIs
explain: Clear structure prevents material being mistaken for instructions.
Say what to do; negative instructions leave the alternative unspecified.

q: How should you test a prompt change?
options: On a set of representative inputs, comparing before and after
explain: Variance between inputs is the norm.
